interpretation.values: All proposal entries are design allocations or retained review inputs, not blanket component specifications or measurements.
interpretation.reference_fraction: 0.2% allocated total. Compounded initial0.05% and6ppm/C BOX over165C consume0.1490495%; remaining0.0509505% must cover applicable line/load,assembly,aging,noise and other terms.
interpretation.comparator_offset: 10mV total equivalent input allocation; includes applicable offset and common-mode/supply/temperature errors, excludes separately enumerated hysteresis and bias.
interpretation.hysteresis: 0..4mV full-width allocation, centered around effective input offset. TLV3202 only specifies1.2mV typical; this allocation is UNVERIFIED.
interpretation.resistors: Independent0.35% per resistor total allocation, not an exact selected resistor specification.
interpretation.timing: 55ns detector,245ns downstream,100ns sensing-settling allocations. None is an end-to-end measured or certified delay. No guaranteed arbitrary ramp response is inferred from step-test delay.
interpretation.bias: 5nA bound at source test common mode; application at reference common mode remains open.
interpretation.overdrive: 20mV beyond worst allocated switching threshold, converted to rail voltage conservatively with maximum divider multiplier. Source conditions still need confirmation.
interpretation.waveform: Continuous monotone ramps only as a conditional budget exercise, after sufficient differential overdrive has been established. Step-through-corridor and narrow pulses are not certified.
interpretation.power: Observation power, reference settling, dead-rail injection, retained fault and final permission chain remain unimplemented.

release_gates: Exact resistor identities and total drift/assembly/aging budget
Bound comparator hysteresis, bias and common-mode/supply errors over chosen conditions
Applicable max delay at actual supply, common mode, loading and declared waveform
Sense-node settling and downstream complete timing/load budget
Reference startup/disable/supply-slew behavior and monitor power-loss/backdrive
Retained clear, ACK/ARM recovery and receiver/watchdog permissions
next_scope: Resolve comparator threshold/delay applicability and the reference/monitor power boundary against this explicit allocation before declaring an isolated native subcell.
